posts.subject: [ENG] Administrator (template) | Read before posting!
posts.bodyHtml:
Here you can find an administrator template which is in English. Applications should look something like this or at least cover similar question.



It is not necessary to follow this template, but it can be used if you like it.
The template represents what should be included in the application.


Before posting your application -> Do I meet the requirements?
0) Do I meet the requirements?
_______________________________


1. What is your name? Real & Ingame
2. How old are you?
3. Why do you want to join our administrative team?
4. How long have you been playing on our servers?
5. What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?
6. Do you think of yourself as mature?
7. Have you gained experience as an administrator before?
8. When do you play? (timetable of your average week)
9. User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
10. Strengths
11. Weaknesses
12. Conclusion / Closing remark



You can submit your application in correct section -> [ENG] Applications
